cs-esc: Customer acme-ai reporting ~50% 503s / timeouts hitting hosted endpoint text-gen-prod since 09:12 UTC. Ticket #5678. sample req IDs: req_abc123, req_def456. cc @samir-oncall @linda-sre :eyes:

samir-oncall: digging in infra. I see continuous container restarts on node gpx-15 in infer-pool-us-east-2. Crash loop started ~09:11. Checking pod logs now.

linda-sre: nvml shows sudden GPU memory surge then errors. Logs show both OOM and a segfault shortly after.

samir-oncall: tail of runner log (09:11:58 -> 09:12:02):
```
[2026-03-17T09:11:58Z] infer-runner[pid:4213]: allocating kv cache size=1.2GB
[2026-03-17T09:12:01Z] infer-runner[pid:4213]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T09:12:01Z] infer-runner[pid:4213]: ERROR: uncaught exception: Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

toni-eng: I can repro locally with the new quantized runtime when seq_len=4096 and batch_size=8 — kv prefetch ramps memory then kernel crashes. repro command: `python repro.py --model text-gen-v2 --seq 4096 --bs 8`

nate-ml: note we rolled quantized v2 into prod at 08:50 (small rollout). v1 was stable. Could be an edge-case with the quantization path touching shared mem sizes.

samir-oncall: quick mitigation applied: updated routing to fallback model text-gen-v1-small for acme-ai at 09:20 UTC. Observed error rate drop to ~2% for that customer. Also flagged endpoint for rate-limited retries.

deploy-bot: Started rolling restart of infer-pool-us-east-2 at 09:25 UTC. Progress: 6/24 pods restarted.

toni-eng: additional local logs: kernel launch returns CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE right before segfault. Might be incorrect shared mem config when num_kv_shards > 1 after quantization.

nate-ml: temp workaround: lower batch_size/buffer window on runtime; confirmed bs=2 avoids OOM locally. Suspect khprefetch change from Mar 15 increased prefetch window.

samir-oncall: triage actions (immediate):
- keep fallback routing for affected customers
- finish rolling restart and, if instability persists, rollback image to v1 in the pool
- collect coredumps + nvprof traces from affected nodes
- update CS with ETA

cs-esc: Customer updated at 09:30 UTC: we routed them to fallback and are investigating; they accepted temporary routing. ETA communicated: ~2h for stabilization.

linda-sre: coredump + gdb backtrace uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/1723456789/coredump.tar.gz. nvprof traces in same bucket.

dev-bot: Repro attempt on small VM with CUDA 12.2 + driver 535 reproduces crash. First hypothesis: a kernel launch with invalid shared mem size triggered by quantized op path.

samir-oncall: status update 10:05 UTC — completed rollback of quantized image to v1 on the affected pool as a precaution. Error rate for text-gen-prod back to normal. Marking incident as mitigated for customer impact.

nate-ml: post-mitigation next steps: restore full telemetry for the rolled nodes, run expanded test matrix for seq <=8192 x bs combinations, add guard checks to kvprefetch and quantized kernel args, and prepare patch.

cs-esc: I'll close the customer-facing loop and send a summary + follow-up RCA ETA.

samir-oncall: creating incident doc and assigning owners: RCA -> nate-ml, infra followup -> linda-sre, rollout QA -> toni-eng. Will attach logs and test results.

cs-esc: incident mitigated for now. Will convert to postmortem once RCA is complete. :white_check_mark:
